mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CT_GALLERY WHERE STATUS='Y'

SELECT CT_GALLERY.GALLERY_NO galleryNo , CT_GALLERY_CATEGORY.CATEGORY_NAME categoryName , CT_MEMBER.NICKNAME nickname , CT_GALLERY.GALLERY_TITLE galleryTitle , CT_GALLERY.VIEW_COUNT viewCount , TO_CHAR(CT_GALLERY.ENROLL_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as enrollDate , CT_GALLERY_ATTACHMENT.FILE_PATH thumnailPath FROM CT_GALLERY JOIN CT_GALLERY_CATEGORY ON CT_GALLERY.CATEGORY_NO = CT_GALLERY_CATEGORY.CATEGORY_NO JOIN CT_MEMBER ON CT_GALLERY.USER_NO = CT_MEMBER.USER_NO LEFT JOIN CT_GALLERY_ATTACHMENT ON CT_GALLERY.GALLERY_NO = CT_GALLERY_ATTACHMENT.GALLERY_NO WHERE CT_GALLERY.STATUS = 'Y' AND CT_GALLERY_ATTACHMENT.ORDER_NO = 1 ORDER BY CT_GALLERY.GALLERY_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT G.GALLERY_NO galleryNo , C.CATEGORY_NAME categoryName , G.GALLERY_TITLE galleryTitle , G.GALLERY_CONTENT galleryContent , G.VIEW_COUNT viewCount , G.ENROLL_DATE enrollDate , M.USER_NAME userName , M.NICKNAME nickname FROM CT_GALLERY G JOIN CT_MEMBER M ON G.USER_NO = M.USER_NO JOIN CT_GALLERY_CATEGORY C ON G.CATEGORY_NO = C.CATEGORY_NO WHERE G.GALLERY_NO = #{galleryNo} AND G.STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT A.FILE_NO fileNo , A.CHANGE_NAME changeName , A.FILE_PATH filePath , A.UPLOAD_DATE uploadDate , A.ORDER_NO orderNo FROM CT_GALLERY G JOIN CT_MEMBER M ON G.USER_NO = M.USER_NO LEFT JOIN CT_GALLERY_ATTACHMENT A ON G.GALLERY_NO = A.GALLERY_NO WHERE G.GALLERY_NO = #{galleryNo} AND G.STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY A.ORDER_NO ASC

SELECT R.REPLY_NO replyNo , R.GALLERY_NO galleryNo , R.USER_NO userNo , M.NICKNAME replyWriter , R.REPLY_CONTENT replyContent , TO_CHAR(R.ENROLL_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') enrollDate , R.STATUS status FROM CT_GALLERY_REPLY R JOIN CT_MEMBER M ON R.USER_NO = M.USER_NO WHERE R.GALLERY_NO = #{galleryNo} AND R.STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY R.REPLY_NO ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CT_GALLERY_REPLY R JOIN CT_MEMBER M ON R.USER_NO = M.USER_NO WHERE R.GALLERY_NO = #{galleryNo} AND STATUS='Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE CT_GALLERY SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1 viewCount WHERE GALLERY_NO = #{galleryNo} AND STATUS = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CT_GALLERY VALUES ( SEQ_RNO.NEXTVAL , (SELECT CATEGORY_NO FROM CT_GALLERY_CATEGORY WHERE CATEGORY_NAME = #{categoryName}) , #{nickname} , #{galleryTitle} , #{galleryContent} , DEFAULT , SYSDATE , 'Y' )
